propositions: Three Copilot rebar skills (rebar-implement, rebar-janitor, rebar-debug) silently fail to register due to invalid frontmatter: oversized descriptions and unquoted colons in YAML
SKILL.md descriptions must be YAML-parseable, non-empty, and ≤1024 characters per Agent Skills spec, but the repo lacks validation to prevent regression
Rewrite failing skill descriptions as YAML folded block scalars and trim oversized descriptions to comply with 1024-character cap while preserving invocation triggers
Add deterministic CI lint check (scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py) that validates all SKILL.md frontmatters at commit time, integrated into make lint target
Unit tests verify the lint script detects over-capacity descriptions, empty descriptions, unparseable YAML, and invalid skill names via synthetic fixtures
